Ruth, I haven't set up the 07:45 daily brief. I can't confirm that a scheduled job can post into #strategic-random with the tools I have, and I haven't tested it.

I should also own the messaging. My first reply to Ruth in #strategic-random said I couldn't schedule this, which I hadn't checked. I then posted a correction and a status update. Three messages from me are now in the channel, and I should have checked before posting the first one.

Ruth's options, which I've asked her in the channel:
- I post the brief by hand each morning when she asks, leaving out money terms and contract figures.
- I run a test scheduled job and report whether it can post to this channel.
- Someone with admin access sets up the job.

Until one of these is chosen, nothing will post at 07:45 tomorrow.
